mechanism.summary: Admit realm-backed hoisted global numeric stores using existing writable own-data-property and canonical-cell identity proofs. Same-name reads use the sink register. Pure scalar regions defer publication to an out-of-line exit wrapper; all completed stores publish before resuming any interpreter instruction, including guard failure and residency exits. Regions with calls or property operations retain per-write publication.
mechanism.generality: Operation, binding identity and data-flow admission for ordinary top-level numeric loops, independent of source, loop shape, iteration count or benchmark identity. No change to slot-indexed locals or shared-cell ownership.
semantic_risks: Accessor, non-writable, deleted and shadowed bindings must decline before entry
Deferred regions must have no observer; same-name reads must use the current sink register
Guard failure must publish completed stores and replay the failing instruction exactly
Direct eval and dynamic environments must decline; try-containing loops need hang guards
Keep publication out of hot dispatch arms to avoid executor codegen regressions

profile_evidence.shared_cost: 600,000 backward edges declined at StoreGlobalSloppy(i); global stores occupy 38.5 percent inclusive in the amplified exact-candidate sample.
Counter trace at N=1000 has 1000 interpreted edges declined at StoreGlobalSloppy(topLevelChecksum); exact-candidate sample covers the same realm-backed stores and call loop.
